name: Cohere Rerank 4
summary: Cohere Rerank 4 is a cross-encoder reranking model released in December 2025 in Pro and Fast variants. It takes a query and a list of candidate documents and returns them reordered by relevance, typically as a second stage after vector or keyword search. Cohere released Rerank 5 on 2026-10-21 as its successor.
facts: Billed per search unit (1 query, up to 100 docs)
goodFor: Second-stage reranking over vector or BM25 results
Long documents that need a 32K window
watchOut: Superseded by Rerank 5; Cohere's pricing page now lists only Rerank 5
Closed weights, API or Model Vault only
Accuracy claims versus other rerankers are vendor-reported
